name: China Mobile Hainan International Data Center
notes: Located in Haikou Jiangdong New Area; reported commissioned on 2024-06-30. Sources state RMB 527m investment, 30,000 sqm building area, 3,840 racks, about 15,000-server installation capacity, and 120P compute scale; no MW figure disclosed.

name: China Telecom Hainan (Haikou) International Information Park Phase 1.1
notes: Haikou Meian International Information Park project. Phase 1.1 reported in formal operation with A1 communications hub, A2 data center, and D1 power center; 46,000 sqm built, 6,000-rack carrying capacity, 717 racks installed. Full park plan cited as 15 specialist buildings, 370,000 sqm, 40,000 racks, RMB 6.75bn total investment.

name: Hainan Lingshui Undersea Data Center
developer: Shenzhen HiCloud Data Centre Technology / Highlander; China Telecom Hainan among first clients
notes: Commercial underwater data center off Lingshui. Sources report first pods deployed in December 2022, first commercial phase completed in 2023, stable operations since 2023 launch, and use by China Telecom Hainan and other customers. Individual underwater cabins are reported at roughly 1,300 tonnes with 24 racks and about 400-500 servers; no MW figure disclosed.

name: China Telecom Hainan (Sanya) International Information Park
notes: Construction-start announcement for a roughly 70-acre next-generation intelligent computing and data center park in Sanya. China Telecom says it will pair with the Haikou International Information Park as Hainan's north-south dual-core data center layout and support cross-border data processing and compute leasing; no MW or rack count disclosed.

division: Hainan - Qiongzhong Li and Miao Autonomous County
